steps.output: The dense basal planar defects are LPSO nanoplates: aggregates of four-layer Zn/Y-segregated fcc-type stacking faults, not conventional stacking faults ; Heat treatment sets nanoplate density and thickness: 9.8 per um and ~28 nm as-grown, ~0.3 per um and ~84 nm after 520 C, ~9.0 per um and ~14 nm after the further 400 C anneal
Yield stress is strongly orientation dependent and, in [11-20] and [01-10], reaches ~145-165 MPa at RT, about 11x the pure-Mg single crystal
